notes.title: Glow effect! Update #2b
notes.notes:
Hello! After a long time, I did this small update. Right now, we're working on a new game, we'll publish more about it soon.

- Removed camera option from Options' menu
- Added glow effect for players that have spin mode activated. 
- Added option to disable the glow effect in the menu

notes.title: Small bugfixes! Update #2a
notes.notes:
Hello, this time I bring a small update with important things, such as a big bug in Quick Match and a change in the difficulty of the training.

- Added Linux version 
- Fixed bug with Quick Match that you can't play with Reds or Blues
- Improved training, too difficult.
- Less discount in the shop (eventually there will be no discount, hehe)

notes.title: New accesories, discounts, and quick matches! Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello, this new update will add a new feature, the Quick Match, something like a "Kick Off" to play with your bought clubs vs the AI. Enjoy it!

DESIGN & MENU
- Added menu news
- Bigger and organized shop
- Added discount to Hats, Sunglasses and balls (-55%) 

CUSTOMIZATION
- Added 6 hats
- Added 6 balls
- Added 6 glasses

GAMEPLAY
- Added new controls for Singleplayer. Use H, J, K to change players. 
- Added "Quick Match", to play with your purchased clubs as AI 

BUGFIXES
- Fixed lots of shields that didn't work

notes.title: Trading cards, controls and training section! Update #1
notes.notes:
This one contains what most people wanted, more information about controls and some tweaks that aren't very important but still good.

Remember that any suggestion or bug report can be made.

- Added trading cards
- Finished Training mode.
- Better training mode with small tutorial included in every note (like controls)
- New texts on loading section
- Better looking on difficulty menu and others
- Added "Change player" controls in Options > Controls menu
- Added new sprite, the ball launcher machine, in the training (for Goalkeepers) and more difficulty
